scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && (cp -n server/.env.example server/.env || true)
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
